description:
Hushfeed v0.19.0 targets TikTok 46.2.3 and ships 68 Morphe patches.

This bundle includes the latest feed, settings, comment, download and playback fixes from main. The publication-age filter is disabled at zero and keeps posts with missing, zero, future or overflowing timestamps visible. Local creator hiding stores stable creator identifiers on the device and includes a searchable editor.

Validation completed locally: 397 runtime tests passed, and the bundle verifier checked all 68 patches and all three DEX payloads. The release asset is accompanied by SHA256SUMS.txt.

Install the .mpp with Morphe Manager after preparing the supported TikTok APK. Keep the existing signing key when patching.
